transfer.waiting: Sent, waiting for the other device to receive
transfer.declined: The other device declined the file.
transfer.withdrawn: The sender withdrew the file. Nothing was received.
transfer.expiredReceived: The transfer expired. Nothing was received.
transfer.expiredSent: The other device did not receive the file before it expired.

diskFull.sent: The other device's disk is full

writeFailed.received: The file could not be saved to the receive folder

verificationFailed.received: The received content does not match what was sent
verificationFailed.sent: The content received by the other device does not match what was sent

deviceOffline.sent: The other device just went offline

fileUnreadable.sent: The file cannot be read; it may have been moved or changed

rejected.sent: The server rejected this transfer; select the file again

quotaExceeded.sent: There is not enough cloud storage

vanished.received: This file is no longer in the cloud drive

destinationChanged.sent: The destination folder changed. Select the file and upload again.

uploadExpired.sent: This upload expired or ended. Upload the file again.
